meta.parties: Babey Nona Et Al. v. Silva

rules.statement: Property subject to a fidei commissum can be lawfully partitioned, but the partition decree does not extinguish the reversionary interest of the fidei commissarius.
rules.supporting_quote: "In my opinion the balance of reason and authority is in favour of the view that property subject to fidei commissum may be the subject of partition, and I hold, in the case under consideration, that the property in dispute, though subject to fidei commissum, was lawfully partitioned. But the partition decree in no way extinguishes the reversionary interest of the fidei commissarius."
